models.display_name: GameUpV2 TSCUNet Small — Compressed Game Video
models.notes: OpenModelDB checkpoint for temporally restoring H.264/H.265/AV1-degraded game footage. Five RGB frames are flattened into the ONNX input and the center frame is emitted. Non-commercial ShareAlike license; input dimensions are reflection-padded to multiples of 64.

models.architecture: Three-frame SOFVSR optical flow with 32nf/12nb RRDB reconstruction
models.notes: Three-frame SOFVSR model for natural, CGI and motion-graphics video. The OpenModelDB card describes multiframe extraction and no strong decompression behavior. ShareAlike license.
